notes: Finding 1 correctly separates integration depth from genuine displacement/multi-PSP counterevidence and uses E-057 as a scope qualification.

Finding 2 achieves the v0.7 regression target: E-043 is correctly classified as qualification evidence for a bounded payment-performance claim, while E-044/E-045/E-046 remain support and counterevidence is empty.

Finding 3 exposes a structural contract problem rather than a clear analytical error. E-040 both supports the existence of new enterprise wins and carries a limitation because selected wins do not quantify revenue contribution.
The v0.7 rule forbidding support/qualification overlap cannot represent that legitimate dual property, so the run fails semantic validation despite analytically useful content.
No retry or model escalation is authorized.
